const double EPSILON = 1e-12;

double dp[MAX_M];
int ones[MAX_M];
double sol[22];
double pr[22];

int main() {
    // Precompute number of 1-bits
    for (int m = 1; m < MAX_M; ++m) {
        ones[m] = ones[m >> 1];
        if (m & 1) ones[m]++;
    }

        cin >> pr[i];

        double sum = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            if (!(mask & (1 << i))) {
                sum += pr[i];
            }
        }
        
        if (sum < EPSILON) continue;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            if (!(mask & (1 << i))) {
                if (ones[mask] < K) {
                    sol[i] += dp[mask] * pr[i] / sum;
                }
                dp[mask | (1 << i)] += dp[mask] * pr[i] / sum;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        printf("%.12f", sol[i]);
        if (i != N - 1) printf(" ");
    }
    printf("\n");
    
    return 0;
